title: Thorp: payoff decomposition and hedged mispricing

sources.sourceRole: Primary publication; account may be retrospective or interested-party

documentedClaim: The author describes convertible-bond and warrant models, hedges and staged risk-taking.
inferredMechanism: Contractual payoff decomposition can identify a mispricing separately from an unhedged directional bet.
counterevidence: Historical modeling advantages can disappear; borrow, financing and changing terms can defeat the apparent hedge.
transferRequirements: Require historical terms, credit exposure, borrow availability, financing and hedge costs; no replication claim based on a modern price model alone.
outcomeBoundary: Public narrative already inspected; described cases are discovery examples, never untouched confirmation. No experimental market outcome dataset opened.
